export function createTurnEndedTracker(
  steeringProviders: ReadonlySet<string> = TURN_ENDED_STEERING_PROVIDERS,
  append: (row: TurnEndLogRow) => void = () => {},
): TurnEndedTracker {
  return {
    inTurn: new Set(),
    permissionWait: new Set(),
    parentOf: new Map(),
    providerOf: new Map(),
    steeringProviders,
    seq: 0,
    flushing: null,
    held: [],
    claimed: new Set(),
    archived: new Set(),
    started: [],
    notedMissing: new Set(),
    silentEnds: new Map(),
    waits: new Map(),
    epoch: 0,
    seatEpoch: new Map(),
    turnMarks: new Map(),
    append,
  };
}
